mapper.select: select sb.Bp_Name as oldBpName, c1.C_Name as bpTendereeName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.*, u2.U_Name as responsibleLeaderName from Sec_Bidding_Plan_Change mn left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Bp_Tenderee left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Bpc_Id left join Sec_Bidding_Plan sb on sb.Bp_Id = mn.Bp_Id left join SYS_User u2 on u2.U_Id=mn.Responsible_Leader where mn.Bpc_Id = #{bpcId}
select count(1) from Sec_Bidding_Plan_Change bp where 1=1

select mn.*, bpc.Bp_Id as bpId, bpc.Bp_Create_Uid as bpCreateUid, bpc.Bp_Create_Uname as bpCreateUname, bpc.Bp_Create_Time as bpCreateTime, bpc.State_Time as bpcStateTime, bpc.State as bpcState from Sec_Info_Change mn left join Sec_Bidding_Plan_Change bpc on bpc.Bpc_Id = mn.Bpc_Id where bpc.Bp_Id = #{bpId}
